feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 November 2026 9:32pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 09 November 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong wind developing.


##Synopsis##

Shallow area of low pressure in the North Sea, with another area of low pressure southwest of Ireland.


##Wind##

East or southeast mainly 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the south overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain in the south of the area later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, backing northeast 2 to 4 overnight into Wednesday. Decreasing 3 or 4 Wednesday morning, then backing north 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain in the south at first, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain at first.
